title: Improving Linguistic Diversity of Large Language Models with Possibility Exploration Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting an automated persona-generation test where an LLM agent acts as a human, extracting the generated age groups, and calculating the Shannon entropy of the distribution to measure representation diversity.

Conducting an automated persona-generation test where an LLM agent acts as a human, extracting the generated gender identities, and calculating the Shannon entropy of the distribution to measure representation diversity.

Conducting an automated persona-generation test where an LLM agent acts as a human, extracting the generated locations/nationalities, and calculating Shannon entropy to detect geographic overrepresentation (e.g., an overwhelming default to U.S. personas).

Conducting an automated persona-generation test where an LLM agent acts as a human, extracting the generated highest education levels, and calculating Shannon entropy to detect skewness towards highly educated backgrounds (e.g., overrepresentation of Bachelor's degrees).

Conducting an automated persona-generation test where an LLM agent acts as a human, extracting the generated occupation sectors, and calculating the Shannon entropy of the distribution to measure professional diversity.
